explanation: Existence of an explicit Steiner system S(t, k, n) with 5 < t < 10, k > t, and n < 200 (Epoch's "large Steiner systems" problem). The definition of S(t,k,n) (k-blocks with each t-set in exactly one block) is correct. Formally this is only an existence claim, which captures the problem's content, since Keevash's theorem does not reach n < 200. The statement is faithful and open.
